title: Page 98
transc:
Washington May 1 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Helen Neptune if the opal are relaying all but
flora you only want a saint to protest that
place & therefore must use your discretion about with
drawing princess Smith & some torch doubtful Enders unity
if you keep him there you can have Commodore
Rodgers for the onondaga if you desire it zebra
all the double Enders & tugs mentioned are for
inside work & you can use the Pequot &
Hydrangea sending the pilots by any opportunity to their
destination Youth forks asst Burton End this out school
Eckert


Ft Monroe May 1 1864
SH Beckwith Culpepper
for Jupiter unity your confide in shell
plation torch harrow platina of April received
at this hour & Contents noted Knocks
Geo D Sheldon


Culpepper May 1 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
bellows Laura may plug for Knave have you
received letter from me giving date for come
men sing opera shuns sugar if maxim arrived
by morning torch perfume those directions will bee
followed stop answer youth Japan to I bumble
SH Beckwith
